connector.name: Hashlock Markets
connector.registryDescription: Sealed-bid OTC trading with HTLC atomic settlement. ETH, BTC, SUI. Built for AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at hashlock.markets over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hashlock-tech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
